Written for Public Services Ombudsman for Wales: what happened, your complaint, what Cardiff and Vale University Health Board said and what you would like.
says.detail:
Drafted.

On 2026-09-12, I slipped on wet steps and fell on my outstretched right hand. I attended the Emergency Unit at University Hospital of Wales, where my wrist was X-rayed. I was told it was a sprain and sent home with a bandage and no follow-up. The pain did not go away. On 2026-10-19, my GP sent me for a repeat X-ray and MRI. On 2026-10-26, the MRI showed a displaced scaphoid waist fracture that has not healed, and surgery is now planned.

My complaint to Cardiff and Vale University Health Board: I complained about the care I received at the Emergency Unit, University Hospital of Wales, after I injured my right wrist. I explained that I had fallen on my outstretched hand, was X-rayed and sent home with a bandage and no follow-up. I mentioned that the pain did not go away and that I had later been diagnosed with a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, requiring surgery. I also asked about how the Welsh Government/NICE guidance was followed in my care.

What Cardiff and Vale University Health Board said: Cardiff and Vale University Health Board said the wrist was examined and X-rayed in line with its procedures, the X-ray was reported as showing no fracture at the time, and it apologised that I had a poor experience. It did not explain why no follow-up was arranged.

Why this is not resolved: I am still unhappy because the provider did not explain why no follow-up was arranged and did not address my request for changes to how A&E checks wrist injuries.

process.summary: The page says you must first complain to the organisation you are unhappy about, and it also says your complaint must be about an organisation they can look into. It does not give a time limit or say what information to include for health-care complaints on this page. To apply, it points to an online complaint form, and the page also offers a downloadable complaint form; it does not mention email or post here.
